description: This Java class represents the ProgramWorkflowState entity in the OpenMRS core project, encapsulating the state within a program workflow, including properties such as concept, initial and terminal flags, and relationships to other entities.

classes.name: ProgramWorkflowState
classes.description: Represents a state within a program workflow, including properties like concept, initial, terminal, and references to its program workflow. Extends BaseChangeableOpenmrsMetadata and is annotated for auditing.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the program workflow state, including its concept, initial, and terminal status.

methods.name: getConcept
methods.description: Retrieves the concept associated with this workflow state.

methods.name: setConcept
methods.description: Sets the concept associated with this workflow state.

methods.name: getInitial
methods.description: Retrieves whether this state is the initial state.

methods.name: setInitial
methods.description: Sets whether this state is the initial state.

methods.name: getTerminal
methods.description: Retrieves whether this state is terminal.

methods.name: setTerminal
methods.description: Sets whether this state is terminal.

methods.name: setProgramWorkflow
methods.description: Associates the ProgramWorkflow object with this state.

methods.name: getProgramWorkflowStateId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier for this ProgramWorkflowState.

methods.name: setProgramWorkflowStateId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier for this ProgramWorkflowState.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Overrides getId() to return the programWorkflowStateId, providing the object's unique id.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Overrides setId() to set the programWorkflowStateId, allowing to assign the id.
